title: Day one: the bath moves to the side garden
body: The bird bath started out the front, tucked into a shrub, and the birds loved it. The front faces a road and a school, though, so it moved to the side garden: enclosed, quieter, and right under a big tree the birds already use.

It keeps its solar fountain, because moving water brings birds in and sounds lovely on camera. A potted tree and a bushy shrub go either side for cover, with a branch to perch on and a flat stone so the smallest birds can stand in shallow water.

title: Next: the camera goes up
body: A weatherproof camera on the wall, framed on the bath and nothing else. Every visit it records gets logged here automatically: time, bird and what it was doing.

title: Later: a fish pond
body: More water, more habitat, and hopefully frogs. It gets its own write-up when it happens.
